_: Collections pass 2026-08-19. The fitting body was the Stryker PDP's new intro almost word for word ('a club at the top of your bag you reach for and then put back').
_facts: All specs from Product Reference Guide v1.8: titanium head, 19° loft, 59° lie, 235 g ±3, 40.5" length, Stiff flex graphite with a mid kick point, 40" original shaft length, 68 g shaft weight, 58 g grip. Finish description is quoted almost directly from the guide.
_driver: This collection was 'Hybrid & Driver' until 2026-07-31. LGD01 is discontinued and v1.8 has no driver section at all, so the collection was renamed rather than left holding a dead tile. When the new driver's specs land, add it back and rename.
_distance: No yardage claim anywhere on this page. '200–220 yd' came off the old Shopify description, not the guide, and the guide is the authority on product facts (HANDOFF §15).

bands.label: The Stryker
bands.lede: Titanium head, nineteen degrees, stiff graphite. One club, one loft, both hands.

fitting.headline: It replaces the club you keep not hitting.
fitting.body: Nineteen degrees is long-iron territory, and a hybrid head gets the ball up from lies a long iron makes you fight. If your longest iron is the one you leave in the bag, this is what goes in its place.
fitting.aside: Hybrids have to come back completely unused inside the sixty days, so decide off a mat before you take it out.

story.headline: One club, and a lot of gold.

rows.photo: Landscape 4:3. Crown-down view of the Stryker at address on fairway turf, so the gold starburst on the gloss black crown reads from the center out. Overcast light, no hard specular.
rows.rowHeadline: The crown is the whole look
paras: Gloss black, with a gold starburst radiating from the center and fading to black at the edges, and the clover mark sitting on top of it. The face is brushed satin gold, the sole is polished mirror gold, and there is a gold ferrule at the hosel.
Three different treatments of the same color on one head is a strange thing to commit to, and it is the reason this club does not look like a hybrid from anywhere else.

rows.photo: Landscape 4:3. Sole-up macro showing the Glide Sole shaping and the mirror finish, held over turf.
rows.rowHeadline: Titanium, and a sole that gets out of the way
paras: The head is titanium with a Flex Channel face and a Glide Sole, at 235 g and a 59° lie. The shaft is a Stiff flex graphite with a mid kick point, playing to 40.5″.
Stiff is the only flex it comes in, and that is worth knowing before you order: the reviews that are not five stars are mostly players who wanted something softer.

quote.q: Played 2 rounds and love swinging and hitting a fairway shot. Best club in my bag now
